headline: WHAT IF YOU WOKE UP AS A PIRATE?

shots.text: What if you woke up as a pirate?
Breakfast? A rock-hard biscuit crawling with bugs.
No fruit for months, so your teeth start falling out.
And the toilet? A hole at the front of the ship.
But walking the plank? Pirates almost never did it.

youtube.title: What If You Woke Up as a Pirate? 🏴‍☠️ #shorts
youtube.description:
What if you woke up as a pirate? 🏴‍☠️

Breakfast would be ship's biscuit (hardtack): a rock-hard cracker that was often crawling with weevils, so sailors tapped it on the table to knock the bugs out. With no fresh fruit for months, you'd get scurvy from a lack of vitamin C: your gums would bleed and your teeth could fall out. And the toilet? It was called 'the head': a seat with a hole at the front of the ship, right over the waves.

But walking the plank? There are only a handful of reports of it ever happening. Most of that comes from books and movies.
